item.title: perf(mantis): build proof lanes runtime-only (#128007)
item.summary: perf(mantis): build proof lanes runtime-only (#128007) The proof gateways execute runtime JS only; declarations forced a ~177s unified rebuild per lane because the declaration cache key is an aggregate source hash. OPENCLAW_RUN_NODE_SKIP_DTS_BUILD=1 on profile full now selects the runtime artifact surface via the uncached generic tsdown graph, both Mantis lanes pass it through, and the baseline archive moves to an isolated mantis-runtime-v1 namespace. Measured candidate build: 177.1s -> 33.05s.
